notes.note: Lombard had his best score since round 10 with 21 disposals and a goal this week. He has been doing enough to hold him. He is an F6 at best but hopefully he is your bench cover.
Lombard had his lowest since round 6. He is a F6 at the best for your side and if you can loop him that would be the best option for your side.
Lombard hasn't dipped below 60 since the bye and this makes him a great bench cover as we see the season through as we run out of trades.

Lombard keeps hanging around in a lot of teams and his 2 goals really helped that sore this week as he  rose in value again. He is possibly one that is scoring well enough to be retained as your bench cover or loop option up forward.
Lombard posted his best score in the last three games and continued his rise in value. Whilst he may rise more he is one you should be looking to upgrade when you can.

Lombard has been a good scorer of late and is providing some value through the byes. If you still hold him he is going to raise in value a bit more but if you have a good upgrade that uses him then do it.
Lombard was back to his regular scoring level with 12 disposals. His BE remains low at 26 so should make some more cash but if you wanted to move him you can.
Lombard had one of his better games and highest score for the year by more than 20 points. 18 disposals and a goal. This saw his BE drop to 17 so you can hold.
Lombard had his second over 50 in a row and made his BE comfortably. His new one of 23 is a good sign for owners and we can keep him til the byes.

Lombard had one of his best games of the season and comfortably got his BE. This has bought him some more time in our sides with a new BE of 20. He won't score like this every week but the BE means we can hold.
Lombard got his BE with a 13 disposal game. But his new BE of 32 means he is on the cusp of needing to be traded.
Lombard has now had three solid games in a row. He won't post huge scores but this seems to be about his range. Probably one more week for him before he starts to lose cash with the BE of 25
Lombard managed 12 disposals and it wasn't his worst game as he did beat his BE. But a new one of 3 means you can hold him a little longer. But plan your escape route.
Lombard had 18 disposals but 14 were by hand with this being his best in the last three. A BE of 26 means we can hold for at least one more week.
11 disposals and 3 free kicks against saw a very low score from Lombard. With his new BE at 13 and the bye this week you could be forgiven for trading as the role wasn't great.
Lombard had a very slow start to the game but did get going but his score was impacted by a couple of goals from his 11 disposals. Not the score we hoped for but he was good for his value.
Lombard has been a popular selection and a couple of goals contributed to his score. He passed the eye test as he certainly looked at home. Pick with confidence.
